# domestic-ui

domestic-ui is a CSS design system built on native HTML, custom properties and cascade layers. Link one stylesheet and semantic HTML is styled in light and dark, with WCAG 2.2 AA as the baseline. Theme it by overriding semantic tokens. It packages existing web standards and patterns; nothing here is original.

[Docs](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/) · [llms.txt](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/llms.txt) · [llms-full.txt](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/llms-full.txt)

## Install and use

Plain CSS, no build step. Copy `css/` from the [repository](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui) into your project and link the entry point:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="css/domestic.css">
```

Imports are relative, so it works from any path. Paths under `css/` are public API ([Agent-friendly by design](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/principles/agent-friendly-by-design.html)).

Components: one `data-<component>` attribute of space-separated words matched with `~=` (`data-button="primary small"`), no classes; state via native attributes and ARIA. Layout primitives and utilities: `.cluster`, `.grid`, `data-scroll`, `.stack`, `.visually-hidden`. Theme by overriding semantic `--dui-*` tokens ([Tokens](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/tokens/index.html)); primitive tokens are internal.

## Components

| Level | Name | API | Docs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Base | Base elements | none: semantic HTML, `data-color-scheme="light" \| "dark"` | [Base elements](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/base.html) |
| Base (utility) | Visually hidden | `class="visually-hidden"` | [Visually hidden](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/utilities/visually-hidden.html) |
| Layout | Cluster | `class="cluster"`, `--cluster-gap`, `--cluster-justify`, `--cluster-align` | [Cluster](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/layouts/cluster.html) |
| Layout | Grid | `class="grid"`, `--grid-min`, `--grid-gap` | [Grid](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/layouts/grid.html) |
| Layout | Scroll | `data-scroll="inline"` | [Scroll](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/layouts/scroll.html) |
| Layout | Stack | `class="stack"`, `--stack-gap` | [Stack](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/layouts/stack.html) |
| Atoms | Text helpers | `data-text="lead \| small \| muted"` (combinable) | [Text helpers](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/atoms/text.html) |
| Atoms | Quiet link | `data-link="quiet"` on `<a href>` | [Quiet link](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/atoms/link.html) |
| Atoms | Buttons | `data-button="[primary \| secondary \| quiet] [small \| large]"` on `<button>`, `<input type=submit\|button\|reset>`, `<a href>`; states `disabled`, `aria-disabled="true"`, `aria-busy="true"` | [Buttons](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/atoms/button.html) |
| Atoms | Form controls | No API; native elements | [Form controls](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/atoms/controls.html) |
| Atoms | Switch | `role="switch"` on `<input type="checkbox">` | [Switch](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/atoms/switch.html) |
| Atoms | Field | `data-field` on the wrapper, `data-field="hint"` and `data-field="error"` on the messages | [Field](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/atoms/field.html) |
| Atoms | Badge | `data-badge="neutral \| accent \| success \| warning \| danger"` | [Badge](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/components/atoms/badge.html) |
| Molecules | Alerts | `data-alert="info \| success \| warning \| danger"`, `data-alert="toasts"`, `data-alert="dismiss"`, `role="status" \| role="alert"` | [Alerts](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/alerts.html) |
| Molecules | Breadcrumb | `data-breadcrumb`, `aria-current="page"` | [Breadcrumb](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/breadcrumb.html) |
| Molecules | Card | `data-card`, `data-card="link"`, `Children: an optional first <img> (or <picture>, <video>) as media,`, `a heading, body content, and an optional <footer> for actions.` | [Card](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/card.html) |
| Molecules | Disclosure | `data-disclosure="accordion"`, `joins them into one bordered block`, `data-disclosure="plain"`, `text inside prose`, `name="group"`, `open` | [Disclosure](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/disclosure.html) |
| Molecules | Menu button | `<dui-menu>`, `popovertarget="menu-id"`, `popover data-popover`, `<button> or <a href> children`, `Added by the component: aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, role="menu",`, `role="menuitem", tabindex="-1".` | [Menu button](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/menu-button.html) |
| Molecules | Pagination | `data-pagination`, `aria-current="page"`, `<a> without href`, `<li aria-hidden="true">…</li>` | [Pagination](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/pagination.html) |
| Molecules | Popover | `data-popover`, `below the invoker, aligned to its start edge`, `data-popover="block-start \| inline-start \| inline-end"`, `place it above or beside the invoker instead`, `role="tooltip"`, `placed above the trigger`, `popover="auto \| manual \| hint"` | [Popover](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/popover.html) |
| Molecules | Search | `<search> > <form> with an <input type="search">`, `the label and any hint span the full width, the input and the submit`, `button share the row below.` | [Search](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/search.html) |
| Molecules | Tabs | `<dui-tabs>`, `<a href="#panel-id"> links, then the panels`, `activation="manual"`, `Space selects (default: automatic)`, `aria-current="true"`, `tab named in the URL fragment, else the first).`, `The component swaps it for aria-selected;`, `aria-selected is not allowed on a link.`, `role="tablist" \| "tab" \| "tabpanel" (added by the component; styled here)` | [Tabs](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/tabs.html) |
| Molecules | Toolbar | `role="toolbar" aria-label="…"`, `aria-orientation="vertical"`, `aria-pressed="true \| false"`, `<hr>` | [Toolbar](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/toolbar.html) |
| Molecules | Typeahead | `<dui-combobox>`, `<option value="…" label="…">`, `dui-combobox-filter`, `element.setOptions([...])` | [Typeahead](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/typeahead.html) |
| Organisms | Dialog and drawer | `data-dialog`, `and the open transition`, `data-dialog="drawer [start \| end]"`, `edge (end is the default)`, `closedby="any \| closerequest \| none"`, `Children: an optional <header> (heading and close button) and <footer>`, `(actions, end-aligned); everything else is the body.` | [Dialog and drawer](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/dialog.html) |
| Organisms | Site navigation | `data-nav="vertical \| horizontal"`, `aria-current="page"`, `<details> / <summary>`, `open to expand it on load, name for`, `one-at-a-time` | [Site navigation](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/nav.html) |
| Tokens | Compact density | see the pattern page | [Compact density](https://odonckers.github.io/domestic-ui/patterns/density.html) |

Docs pages also link how other design systems handle the same thing, for comparison only.

## Demos

- **Accessibility checker** ([`demos/a11y/`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/a11y)): Checks the built demo apps the same way the repository checks `examples/`: Playwright with [axe](https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core) (tags `wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `wcag21a`, `wcag21aa`, `wcag22aa`), in light and dark, with every `<details>` opened and checked again.
- **Angular** ([`demos/angular/`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/angular)): The dashboard and account settings views in Angular 22: standalone components, two routes (`''` and `'settings'`) with Angular Router, a `title` per route, and `routerLinkActive` with `ariaCurrentWhenActive="page"` for the current link.
- **Astro** ([`demos/astro/`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/astro)): The dashboard and account settings views as two static Astro pages (`src/pages/index.astro` and `src/pages/settings.astro`) sharing `src/layouts/Base.astro`.
- **React** ([`demos/react/`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/react)): The dashboard and account settings views in React 19 with Vite, as a two-page [multi-page app](https://vite.dev/guide/build#multi-page-app) (`index.html` and `settings.html`).
- **Plain HTML** ([`demos/vanilla/`](https://github.com/odonckers/domestic-ui/tree/main/demos/vanilla)): The dashboard and account settings views as two static HTML files, with no build step.
